load_and_preprocess_data: load and preprocess computational and experimental CSV data with XRD matching for CO2R or HER reaction analysis
get_and_apply_xrf_mapping: build an XRF composition mapping from XRF data and apply it to experimental data to filter valid samples
get_production_rate: compute the production rate in mol per cm squared per second from faradaic efficiency and current density
get_distance_between_formulas: calculate the euclidean distance between two chemical composition formulas like Pt-0.5-Pd-0.5
add_cv_categories: add leave-one-out and leave-one-composition-out cross-validation category columns to a dataframe for ML training
